title: Hickman’s road to Secret Wars
subtitle: Two Avengers titles, Infinity, and Time Runs Out converge on the 2015 finale.
intro: Hickman’s Avengers saga began in 2012; Secret Wars began in 2015 and finished in 2016. Follow both Avengers (2012) and New Avengers (2013). The Core filter keeps the full Avengers-to-Secret Wars path. The Fantastic Four opening and Avengers World are optional context. Issue lists below provide a practical narrative order; parallel chapters can be arranged slightly differently by different guides. For Infinity and Time Runs Out, the combined collections are the easiest way to follow the crossover. Battleworld tie-ins are optional.
